children: Tesla will design and test about 10 chip designs yearly at Terafab’s Giga Texas research fab to speed chip development; major designs typically take ~2 years to reach volume production.

Tesla (TSLA) Cybertruck sales remain far below CEO Elon Musk’s 250,000 annual target; recent quarterly shipments are well under the quarterly run-rate needed to hit that goal.
Tesla (TSLA) got a 30-day NHTSA extension to Oct. 30 to answer 21 safety certification questions on Cybercabs, including compliance with brake standards for pedal-less vehicles.
Tesla (TSLA) is rebranding its European Full Self-Driving label from “Full Self-Driving (Supervised)” to “Tesla Assisted Driving” after German officials said the old name could mislead drivers.
Tesla (TSLA) delays robotaxi rollout, citing cautious expansion. CEO Elon Musk says company is testing tough scenarios—low-visibility animal detection and railroad crossings—before adding new cities.
Tesla reopened $50,000 Roadster reservations and set the official debut for October 1, 2026, reinstating the $50,000 deposit for buyers.
Investor Gary Black urges Tesla (TSLA) to boost marketing, adopting Apple-like promos as it expands into robotaxis and humanoid robots, warning weak ads could cede EV market share to rivals.
Ross Gerber says Tesla’s Roadster may be a limited run of a few hundred units, calls its hovering feature a gimmick, and notes interest in an electric car with speed, range, and autonomy.
